citations.assessment: The checked chapter has several reports by Yehoshua of Sikhnin in Levi’s name. The co-attribution to Yehudah ben Niron is absent from the inspected passages and remains an edition-specific hold.

holds.reason: Midrash Shmuel 9:6–7 supports the named Yehoshua–Levi chain. The printed or manuscript reading with Niron as co-transmitter remains unlocated.

notes.text: The link supports only the Yehoshua–Levi chain. Keep the received Niron spelling and leave the co-attribution open.
